en: I forgave my friend yesterday.
I did not give up my right.
Did you forgive your cousin?

lat: nta ma sme7tish f l-khedma dyalek
en: You did not abandon your job.
You (f.) forgave your sister just now.
You did not forgive the thief.
He gave up the old house.
He did not forgive his friend.
She forgave her husband.
She did not give up the money.
We gave up everything yesterday.
We did not forgive that boy.
Did you (pl.) forgive your son?
You did not forgive the neighbour.
They gave up their place.
They did not forgive their son.
I always forgive people.
I do not forgive a liar.
You always forgive your friend.
Why do you not let go of the past?
You forgive your sister quickly.
You do not neglect work.
He always forgives everyone.
He does not neglect his son.
The mother always forgives her children.

lat: hiya ma katsme7sh l dak r-rajel
en: She does not forgive that man.
We always forgive each other.
We do not give up our house.

lat: wash ntuma dima katsem7u l n-nas
en: Do you always forgive people?
You (pl.) do not neglect your children.
Parents always forgive their children.

lat: huma ma kaysem7ush f l-7eqq dyalhum
en: They do not give up their right.

lat: ana ghadi nsme7 l khuya daba
en: I am going to forgive my brother now.

lat: ma ghadish nsme7 f l-karama dyali
en: I am not going to give up my dignity.

lat: wash nta ghadi tsme7 l sa7bek
en: Are you going to forgive your friend?

lat: nta ma ghadish tsme7 f l-khedma
en: You are not going to give up the job.

lat: nti ghadi tsem7i l khtek ghedda
en: You are going to forgive your sister tomorrow.

lat: nti ma ghadish tsem7i f l-7eqq dyalek
ar: نتي ما غاديش تسمحي فالحق ديالك
en: You are not going to give up your right.
He is going to forgive his cousin.

lat: huwa ma ghadish ysme7 f l-ma7all dyalu
ar: هو ما غاديش يسمح فالمحل ديالو
en: He is not going to give up his shop.

lat: hiya ghadi tsme7 l sa7batha l-yum
en: She is going to forgive her friend today.

lat: hiya ma ghadish tsme7 f d-dar
en: She is not going to give up the house.
We are going to forgive that man.

lat: 7na ma ghadish nsem7u f l-ard dyalna
ar: حنا ما غاديش نسمحو فالارض ديالنا
en: We are not going to give up our land.

lat: wash ntuma ghadi tsem7u l l-jar
en: Are you going to forgive the neighbour?

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tsem7u f l-fulus dyalkum
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تسمحو فالفلوس ديالكم
en: You are not going to give up your money.

lat: huma ghadi ysem7u l kulshi l-yum
en: They are going to forgive everyone today.

lat: huma ma ghadish ysem7u f l-wlad dyalhum
ar: هما ما غاديش يسمحو فالولاد ديالهم
en: They are not going to abandon their children.
